title: 교통사고가 났을 때: 경찰에게 어떻게 말해요?
objective: Tell a police officer whether you are hurt and explain what happened, using -기 때문에.
summary: Learn to talk to a police officer after a small car accident, giving reasons with -기 때문에.
setting: A rainy evening at a crossroads. Mark stopped at a red light and the car behind hit his car. A police officer arrives and talks to Mark and the other driver.

task.title: Explain the accident
task.line: Fill in the blank, choose a word, or write a short Korean sentence. Use -기 때문에 where the item asks for it.

words.exampleMeaning: There was an accident at the intersection in front of my house.

words.meaning: to stop (a moving car or person)

words.exampleMeaning: The car behind me is getting too close.
It snowed, so the road is slippery.
I left my driver's license at home.

dialogue.meaning: Are you okay? Are you hurt anywhere?

dialogue.korean: 신호가 빨간불이었기 때문에 제가 멈췄어요. 그런데 뒤차가 제 차를 박았어요.
dialogue.meaning: The light was red, so I stopped. But the car behind me hit my car.

dialogue.korean: 죄송합니다. 길이 미끄러웠기 때문에 브레이크를 밟아도 차가 안 섰어요.
dialogue.meaning: I'm sorry. The road was slippery, so my car didn't stop even when I hit the brakes.

dialogue.korean: 두 분 다 면허증하고 보험 회사 연락처 좀 보여 주세요.
dialogue.meaning: Both of you, please show me your driver's licenses and your insurance company contact details.

exercises: Fill in the blank with the -기 때문에 form of 다치다 (past): 다리를 ____ 걸을 수 없어요.
Choose the right word: 눈이 와서 길이 (미끄러워요 / 멈춰요).
Make one sentence with -기 때문에: 앞차가 갑자기 섰어요. + 저도 급하게 멈췄어요.
Choose the word the police officer needs: 경찰: 운전하셨어요? 그럼 ____ 좀 보여 주세요. (면허증 / 신호 / 뒤차)
Answer in Korean with -기 때문에, using 사고가 나다: 왜 보험 회사에 전화했어요?
answers: 앞차가 갑자기 섰기 때문에 저도 급하게 멈췄어요.
사고가 났기 때문에 보험 회사에 전화했어요. (사고가 났기 때문에 전화했어요.)
